provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver changed a 19 month old childs diaper & did not was her hands after.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §747.3211(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child woke up from naptime, used the restroom & did not wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher's last service date was August 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One out of eight children's files reviewed lacked required health statement signed by a doctor or health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction: Three out of the three staff files reviewed lacked required trainings for the last full employment year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of eight children's files did not have signed medical authorizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of nine children's files did not contain a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four of nine files did not have address information for emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: Th permit holder and both assistants did not have a personnel file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The permit holder had verification of 25 of the required 30 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two of nine children's files did not have signed medical authorizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Six of nine children's files did not have a current immunization record.      Five of nine files did not have a signed physician's statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher's last service date was Nov/2017.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 747.307 within 5 Days: The operation notified all parents of a safe sleep deficiency, but failed to notify all parents with children enrolled of the safe sleep deficiency within the required time frame of 5 days.     Note: This was corrected during the inspection when the the permit holder signed a written statement that she understands all safe sleep deficiencies require that all parents be notified within 5 days of receiving the deficiency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 747.307 within 5 Days (26 TAC §747.309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 out of the 10 children's records reviewed did not have immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: There was a blanket inside a crib with an infant under the age of 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §747.2315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 1 out of the 10 children's files did not have updated immunizations records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: There was an infant in a play yard that had a very loose fitted sheet over the mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation: The operations emergency preparedness plan was missing specific procedures on the following topics:      How staff will evacuate and relocate with the essential documentation including (A) Parent and emergency contact telephone numbers for each child in care, (B) Authorization for emergency care for each child in care & (C) The child tracking system information for children in care
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation (26 TAC §747.5003(3))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver did not have training for the previous training year in the following topics:   (1) Emergency preparedness, (2) Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations, (3) Administering medication, if applicable,(4) Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, (5) Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic & (6) Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The operations fire extenguisher was located inside of a closed cabinet and was not mounted to the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction: The substitute caregiver did not have training for the previous training year in the following topics:  (1) Emergency preparedness, (2) Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations, (3) Administering medication, if applicable,(4) Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, (5) Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic & (6) Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The operations emergency preparedness plan was missing  specific procedures on the following topics:     (1) How children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area or alternate shelter, including specific procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There were mutiple outlets located throughout the operation that did not have outlet covers.     Note: This was corrected during the inspection when a caregiver covered all of the outlets with outlet covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: Two children's files were missing health statement and parent signature stating has been seen by medical professional within twelve months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
